examples.description: Drop the [silence] rows from the transcript

description: Delete every '[silence]' row from the TRANSCRIPT. This cleans up the caption text only - the footage keeps its full length and the pauses still play. To cut the pauses out of the video for real, use remove_dead_air. Silence rows are derived markers, not content, so this is a HARD delete and is not undoable - re-run transcription to get them back.
